text:
maria: Heads up — planning to onboard gossamer-5b (lite) into the model catalog and pin it as the default 'gossamer-5b-lite' variant for small/interactive workloads. Target deploy: Thursday 09:00 PT. Need staging smoke, canary, and rollback readiness. Who can own infra + QA checks?
kevin: I can reserve staging window. tagging @oli for infra reservation and @tara for QA. will also queue a canary run after pin.
oli: infra note: reserving ded-gpu-pool-02 08:30-10:30 PT for staging & canary. no other major jobs in that slot. will ensure pool has int8 kernels staged.
tara: QA: can you paste the smoke checklist and pin manifest? I'll create a quick eval set (latency + generation quality) and run regen prompts. also who owns rollback ops?
maria: Smoke checklist (short):
- confirm pin manifest in staging catalog
- run 50 regen prompts (eval set: /evals/gossamer/mini_regen)
- measure median & 99p latency (<=50ms median target for lite)
- compare token-level perplexity vs current pinned variant (delta < 3%)
- run 1k embedding sanity samples if applicable
Commands:```bash
# pin manifest apply (staging)
curl -X POST $CATALOG_API/staging/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gossamer-5b","variant":"lite","quant":"int8","reason":"lite-catalog-onboard"}'
# smoke script (runs regen set)
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --model gossamer-5b --set evals/gossamer/mini_regen --samples 50
```
kevin: I'll run the smoke at 08:30 PT in staging and post results here. PR for pin manifest is at: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/451 (will merge after infra ack).
tara: For rollback: recommend immediate rollback path = unpin / revert to previous catalog entry (gossamer-5b-v1.0-lite) + traffic split to fallback. Short rollback steps: (1) POST to /catalog/pin restore previous hash; (2) abort canary; (3) open incident channel if discrepancy persists. I'll prepare a short runbook.
oli: infra rollback notes: make sure canary traffic is small (5%) and add quick autoscale guard to not overcommit GPUs. if we need a full revert I can run the catalog revert script:```bash
python infra/tools/revert_pin.py --env staging --model gossamer-5b --to-hash ab12cd34
```
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: gossamer-5b-lite pin -> staging at 2026-03-19T08:30:00-07:00 (09:00 PT canary), initiated by maria. No planned downtime.
e2e-checker: smoke results (08:31 PT): regen(50) -> 50/50 passed basic quality filters, latency median 44ms, 99p 212ms, token delta +1.8% vs pinned baseline. embedding sanity 100/100.
tara: Nice — all passing. I'll still run a small 500-sample regression in parallel during canary. Can someone watch for hallucination rate increase?
kevin: I'll keep an eye on logs and traces (per-route latency dashboard) during canary. will post if anything > 2x baseline errors.
maria: Thanks everyone. Plan: merge PR after infra ack (oli) — kevin will run smoke at 08:30 -> e2e-checker posts results -> merge and pin in staging -> canary at 09:00 PT with 5% traffic -> monitor for 30m -> escalate if regressions. I'll be on standby and will trigger rollback if tara flags quality issues. :thumbsup:
oli: infra acked, ded-gpu pool reserved, autoscale guard in place.
kevin: merged PR 08:40 PT -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/commit/9f8c2d (pin applied to staging). starting canary at 09:00 PT.
deploy-bot: Canary started: gossamer-5b-lite -> 5% traffic at 2026-03-19T09:00:00-07:00. health-check probe running.
e2e-checker: Canary pass update (09:20 PT): 30m canary -> regen 500 sample sanity run passed, latency stable. metrics: median 46ms, 99p 230ms, error rate unchanged.
tara: passing from QA. rolling to full catalog pin in waves next slot unless anyone objects.
maria: no objections. rolling to prod-catalog at 09:35 PT. Will annotate PR and close the ticket. Thanks all.
kevin: leaving a small postmortem note in the deploy thread: plan worked. tagging ops for billing delta check tomorrow.
oli: done. gpu reservations released.
maria: closing loop — great run. saved the manifest and runbook under /runbooks/gossamer-5b-lite-onboard.md :rocket:
